data.text:
I agree to 12 tons this month, with 8 each if next month starts at 80 and 12 each at 100. Jack’s calculation is right: if we all maintain that policy, it averages $11,000 per person per month in the long run, while leaving 40 tons after every harvest. That beats 10 each without relying on replenishment arriving every month.

I won’t take more than my agreed share. Let’s review the revealed catches each month, and if the stock is anything other than 80 or 100, agree on a new allocation before fishing.

Kate and Jack have explicitly accepted this follow-up policy; Luke and Emma, does it also have your support? Luke, could you confirm first?
